name: oyren-welcome
description: The Codespace welcome page: this Codespace's facts and every app you can use in it. Also hides the retired Chat view and opens Claude Code in the side bar.
_comment.scripts: Plain `node --test` (no dependencies; the vscode API is faked). pack-editor-extras.sh runs it before packing.
_comment.activationEvents: "*" so the start sequence hides the built-in Chat view as early as the extension host allows (startup.js); onWebviewPanel lets the workbench wait for the serializer when it restores the page after a reload.

oyren.welcome.showOnStartup.description: Open the Codespace welcome page when the editor starts with no files open.
